title: US President Trump arrives in Manila ahead of ASEAN summit
html:
US President Trump arrives in Manila ahead of ASEAN summit

US President Donald Trump has landed in Manila ahead of a special ASEAN-US meeting, before travelling to China for the APEC Summit, where he is scheduled to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
summary: US President Donald Trump has landed in Manila ahead of a special ASEAN-US meeting.
